verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor, so choosing a cloud storage region or data-residency location is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself offers region or residency selection. Its on-device AI positioning is a different capability and does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
